As a new user, I want to register with my name, mobile number and password, so that I get an account and a wallet without any manual setup.
Acceptance Criteria
The Register screen shows first name, last name, mobile number, password and confirm password fields.
If the mobile number is already registered, the screen shows "mobile number already registered" and no account is created.
If password and confirm password do not match, an inline error is shown and submission is blocked.
If the password does not meet the minimum strength rules, an error is shown and registration is blocked.
On successful registration, an account and a wallet are both created.
If the wallet cannot be created, no account is created either.
After successful registration, the user is signed in and taken to the dashboard without logging in separately.
The Register screen has a link to Login for existing users.
The password is never visible or shown in any message.

issues.description:
As a user who has forgotten my password, I want to reset it using a one-time password (OTP) sent to my registered contact, so that I can regain access without contacting support.
Acceptance Criteria
Step 1 shows a mobile/email field and a "Request OTP" button.
On request, a 6-digit OTP is sent to the user's registered contact and is valid for a limited time.
The number of OTP requests per user is limited to prevent spam.
Step 2 shows an OTP field, a new password field and a confirm password field.
If the OTP is wrong or expired, "invalid or expired OTP" is shown and the reset is blocked.
New password and confirm password must match and must meet the same strength rules as registration.
On successful reset, the password is updated, the OTP can no longer be used, and a success message is shown.
After a successful reset, the user must log in again with the new password. No automatic login happens.

issues.description:
As an admin, I want to review pending KYC documents and approve or reject them, so that users' KYC status reflects verified identity and money-transfer features are gated correctly.

If a user has several documents, the admin can act on each one separately.
Every approve or reject action shows which admin performed it.
The admin can open the uploaded file securely, without a public link.

issues.description:
Set up the repository, CI/CD pipeline, dev and staging environments, and provision Postgres and Redis.
Acceptance Criteria
1. The repository has frontend and backend structure, linting and a branch strategy.
2. CI runs build and tests on every pull request.
3. Postgres and Redis run in dev and staging.
4. Secrets are stored in environment config, not in code.

Create migrations for users, wallets, transactions, transfers, ledger_entries and kyc_documents, including kyc_status, verified_by and verified_at.
Acceptance Criteria
1. Migrations run cleanly on a fresh database.
2. Foreign keys and indexes exist (for example a unique index on mobile number and an index on gateway_payment_id).
3. The schema is reviewed against all 13 stories.

Build the service that writes debit and credit ledger entries inside a database transaction and derives the wallet balance from them. Balances are never updated directly.
Acceptance Criteria
1. A credit and a debit can be written together in one transaction.
2. The balance is calculated from ledger entries only. 3. Concurrent debits cannot take a wallet below zero, proven by a test.

Description: Implement JWT access and refresh tokens, auth guards, an admin role guard and the token blacklist check. Include a unique token ID in access tokens so they can be blocked at logout.
Acceptance Criteria
1. Protected routes reject missing or invalid tokens.
2. Admin-only routes reject non-admin users.
3. A blacklisted token is rejected without a database query.

Create the Razorpay test account, store the keys, and build the webhook endpoint with signature verification.
Acceptance Criteria
1. Test keys are stored in config.
2. The webhook endpoint is reachable from Razorpay (use a tunnel in dev).
3. Requests with an invalid signature are rejected.

Integrate an email provider so the backend can send OTP emails.
Acceptance Criteria
1. The backend can send a test email from dev and staging.
2. The sender domain and API key are configured.
3. Send failures are logged without exposing the OTP.

issues.summary: Secure KYC file storage and download route
issues.description:
Store uploaded files outside the web server's public folder and expose them only through an authenticated backend route that allows the owner or an admin.
Acceptance Criteria
1. Files are not reachable by any public URL.
2. The owner and admins can fetch a file. Other users get a 403 response.
3. File type and size limits are configured.

issues.summary: Seed script (admin user and test data)
issues.description:
Create a script that inserts a first admin user and sample users, wallets and transactions.
Acceptance Criteria
1. Running the script on a fresh database creates a working admin login.
2. Test users exist in different KYC states (pending, verified, rejected).
3. The script is safe to re-run and is never run in production.
